card.name: Start of capitalized medical terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that is split into parts, often a capitalized or all-caps term such as ST in STROKE, St. in St. John's Wort, or S in SJS. It appears mostly in headings and warnings in drug labels.

modes.label: Opening letters of heading terms
modes.description: A short first piece of a capitalized warning or section-heading word, with the rest of the word following.
modes.example: WARNING: AUTOIMMUNITY, INFUSION REACTIONS,<< ST>>ROKE, AND MALIGNANCIES See

modes.label: St. before John's Wort
modes.description: The abbreviation St in interaction headings about St. John's Wort.
modes.example: 5.10 Interaction with<< St>>. John’s Wort or Rifampin

modes.label: Start of acronym or abbreviation
modes.description: The first letter of an acronym or a cancer type code that is split into pieces.
modes.example: risk of<< S>>JS/TEN/DRESS is largely confined
